bullets: Advertising spots in the Freebuff terminal now disappear if they stay on screen too long.
New accounts no longer see a menu for picking an AI model and use default settings automatically.
Settings search now includes the Apps and downloads page and related setup instructions.
The desktop cloud service recognizes when a coding assistant answers on its own after a background task ends.
The desktop app overview now keeps the 20 most recently finished background tasks for 30 minutes.
The coding assistant now suggests brainstorming ideas at any stopping point rather than only after a specific task.
The internal rules for rolling out desktop updates now support gradual delivery and stopping bad updates.
